elements.label: Warp Drive view replacing the Rules page in the app window
Share popover: invite email field and Invite button
Share link row with Copy link

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Sits ~1.09 s after event start, at the very right edge of the spectrogram, so its shape is not visible; CLAP says music (0.418) and nothing visual happens then in this packet. Likely part of the music bed, not a UI SFX.

pattern.description: Inside the fixed app window beside the presenter, the Rules page slides away and a Warp Drive view (sidebar plus share popover with invite field, access list and link) slides in from the right, timed to 'the ability to share prompts'.
pattern.why_premium: Same locked window frame and eased page slide as the previous feature (e020), so a run of features reads as one continuous product walkthrough; the arriving screen is pre-staged with a typed email and cursor, showing the feature already in use.

build_hint.gsap: Window overflow hidden; gsap.timeline().to(rulesPage, {xPercent: -30, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).fromTo(drivePage, {xPercent: 100}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '<'); popover moves with the page (no separate stagger visible).
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 16], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); old page translateX(-30%*p) opacity 1-p; new page (sidebar + popover) translateX((1-p)*100%) inside an overflow:hidden window.

notes: Same transition style as e020 (both shot s026); worth a human check whether both should share one canonical id (e.g. a new 'ui page slide' pattern vs layout_reframe). The cursor in the popover has no candidate box and appears static, so it is not listed.
